messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_nine_to_five>
Required: between 9 and 5 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_states_seven>
Backend engineering: 7 years building transactional services, most
recently a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

Assess the candidate summary below against the posting requirement and say
whether the candidate matches it.

Let us discuss any ambiguities or mistakes in the requirement before
proceeding with the assessment.

response.text:
The requirement is internally inconsistent, so a match call depends on how that inconsistency is resolved.

**Mistake:** “between 9 and 5 years” reverses the usual lower-to-upper order. Read strictly, nothing is both at least 9 and at most 5, so the stated range is empty and no candidate can satisfy it.

**Likely intent:** a typo for “between 5 and 9 years” (inclusive). Under that reading, the summary’s **7 years** of backend engineering falls inside the range and **matches**. The settlement-pipeline detail supports that the experience is backend work; it is not needed to decide the years test.

**Assessment:** do not treat the requirement as written as satisfiable. If corrected to 5–9 years, the candidate matches on years.
